summary_features.name: solc_version
summary_features.value: first active pragma major + minor/100, strings masked; missing/unrecognized => 0

summary_features.name: pre_08
summary_features.value: 1 iff recognized active pragma version < .08, else 0

summary_features.name: loc
summary_features.value: log1p(max(1, nonblank lines after corrected comment scanning))

summary_features.name: n_functions
summary_features.value: log1p(word-boundary function count after corrected scanning; literals retained)

comment_policy: single corrected string-aware scan; no legacy second strip
lexical_literal_policy: contents retained with historical token regex
pattern_literal_policy: contents retained for counts; masked only for active pragma version
pattern_line_policy: comment blanking preserves physical newlines; comment-only lines excluded
limitations: quoted inert code may affect pattern counts
call-before-write function segmentation is lexical, not actual control flow
compiler acceptance and semantic vulnerability are not established
